test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The pack of wolves moving towards the children __are a frightening sight__.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'was a frightening sight'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, 'was a frightening sight'
